NNEW CONCEPT ENGLISHBOOK 01 / 新概念英语

BOOK ONE · LESSON 080

I must go to the ...

我必须去……

A picture lesson in which students match numbered shop items (groceries, fruit and vegetables, meat, stationery, and baker/chemist goods) with the shop where they are bought. Written exercises rewrite negative have-got sentences as 'haven't got' and make two statements (need/must go) for each question. Workbook practice covers sentences with 'so or because' and about-you shopping questions. Grammar exercises cover giving correct replies with 'need ...' and answering have-got questions with 'must go to the ... to get/buy some'.

80 / 144 LESSONS3 PARTSREAD · WRITE · PRACTISE
01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

GROCER'S to get some GROCERIES:
cheese (120) / eggs (121) / butter (122) / honey (123) / jam (124) / biscuits (125)

GREENGROCER'S to get some FRUIT and VEGETABLES:
pears (226) / oranges (227) / bananas (228) / beans (229) / peas (230) / cabbages (231)

BUTCHER'S to get some MEAT:
lamb (332) / beef (333) / steak (334) / mince (335) / chicken (336)

NEWSAGENT'S to get some STATIONERY:
glue (437) / envelopes (438) / writing paper (439) / newspapers (440) / magazines (441)

BAKER'S to get some:
bread (543) / cakes (544)

CHEMIST'S to get some:
aspirins (545) / medicine (546)

Match each numbered item with the shop where it is sold.

Listening — match the items with the shops

Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。
1. Where can you get some cheese?
2. Where can you get some steak?
3. Where can you get some writing paper?
4. Where can you get some bread?
5. Where can you get some medicine?

Answer each question with the correct shop.

Written A — Rewrite these sentences

A Rewrite these sentences. 模仿例句改写以下句子。
Examples: I don't have any eggs. → I haven't got many eggs.
He doesn't have any coffee. → He hasn't got much coffee.

Rewrite each sentence using haven't got.

Written B — Make two statements for each question

B Make two statements for each question, as in the examples. 模仿例句用两种方式回答以下每个问题。
Example: Have you got any cheese? (grocer's) → I need a lot of cheese. I haven't got much. I must go to the grocer's to get some cheese.
Example: Has he got any envelopes? (newsagent's) → He needs a lot of envelopes. He hasn't got many. He must go to the newsagent's to get some envelopes.

For each question, write a need statement and a must-go statement.

02

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Practice 练习

A — We must go to the ... with so or because

Use these words to write sentences using must, so and because. 用所给单词造句，用 must, so and because。
Example: we / bread / baker's → We haven't got any bread so we must go to the baker's to get some. / We must go to the baker's to get some bread because we haven't got any.

Write two sentences for each set of cues: one with 'so' and one with 'because'.

Item 1 is a printed example. Items 2-5 are taken from the workbook key (img/key-080-085.jpg).

B — About you

What must you buy or get this week? Where? And when? Write five sentences like this. 写出 5 个句子，说明你本周要买的商品以及采购的地点和时间。
Example: I must go to the newsagent's tomorrow to get some envelopes.

Write sentences about what you must buy or get this week, where, and when.

Open-ended; possible answers are taken from the workbook key (img/key-080-085.jpg).

03

BUILD YOUR FOUNDATION

Grammar 语法练习

I. Give correct replies, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词写出下列各句的对应句。

Give correct replies, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词写出下列各句的对应句。
Example: You look tired. (a rest) → You need a rest.

Give the correct reply for each cue using 'need'.

Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 510-511).

II. Answer the questions according to the example. 仿照例句回答下列问题。

Answer the questions according to the example. 仿照例句回答下列问题。
Example: Do we have any honey? (grocer's/get) → No, we don't. We must go to the grocer's to get some.

Answer each question with a negative reply and a must-go statement, following the example.
